fr_cargaison_noun.why: English sound-alike painted in musee/bateau_pirate (Oct 31 2026 Musée fix pack): two dress-up children gazing at a shiny red toy car on top of a stack of cargo crates and sacks.

fr_cale_noun.hook: "KAHL": a sailor CALLS down through the hatch into the dark hold: KAHL = CALL
fr_cale_noun.why: English sound-alike painted in musee/bateau_pirate (Oct 31 2026 Musée fix pack): a sailor kneeling at an open deck hatch, hands cupped, calling down into the dark hold. Gate 29 second sense.
fr_cale_noun.note: The hold of a ship; also a wedge put under a wobbly table leg.
